questions.Description:
a) Download, Install and Activate Ui-Path Studio. Learn all the basics of RPA (Variables,
arguments and Control flow etc.)
b) Write a program to read an Excel file and creating a data table by using
data from the Excel file.

a) Write a program to empty the trash folder in Gmail.
b) Write a program to demonstrate the concept of dynamic elements in UI Path
selectors.

a) Write a program in UI Path that utilizes the If activity and Switch activity to find the
smallest and largest numbers in an array.
b) Write a program to demonstrate email automation. (Note: use triggers and exception handling)

a) Write a program in UI Path that utilizes the While activity, Do-While activity, and For-Eachactivity to increment an integer variable from 5 to 50 in increments of 5.
b) Create an automation project in Ui Path studio and publish and control the same using ui path
orchestrator.

a) Write a program to
i) build a data table(static)
ii) build a data table using data scraping (Dynamically).
b)Write a program to demonstrate manage package, upload package and deleting package for are usable component
